body.name: Observed-experiment estimator class
body.construction: Set \(\mathcal O_{n,m}=\sigma(A,Y,p)\) and \(\mathfrak E_{n,m}=\{\widetilde U:\widetilde U\text{ is }\mathcal O_{n,m}\text{-measurable and }\widetilde U\in\mathbb O_{n,r}\}\).
inputs: The observed assignments, outcomes, and recorded propensities; deterministic frames and deterministic selectors between observed-data estimators are evaluated by this measurability criterion.
